_doc: Phase 7, blocks E/F: regulated corridors for the ADAS research scenarios, their R-19 signs and the Event 01 start. Road speed values live in working/functional/speed_changes.json (plan ids adas50_zone, adas50_exit_120, event01_corridor_70); this file holds the scenario geometry. Sign/spawn positions are measured in the game by working/functional/place_signs.py and frozen under _measured (the generator never talks to the game).

adas50.doc: Southwest freeway carriageway (one-way, 4 lanes) at the start of the zone: DR694 (120) -> DR312 (DR694_9, 556.8 / 790.0).

adas50_spawn.doc: From the ADAS Speed Alert spawn along DR312 (edge DR253_6 -> DR312_9; the DR253 exit ramp diverges here, the route stays on the freeway).

adas50_exit.doc: From the DR312 -> DR758 junction (end of the 50 zone) onwards.

event01.doc: Northbound avenue carriageway DR652 (one-way, 2 lanes), from the signalised junction DR192_5 to the ramp DR663/DR659.

zones.doc: Spawn (431.2, 701.6) lies on DR312 (navgraph edge DR253_6 -> DR312_9, 1 m from the axis). DR312 is a road_invisible AI road (no visual mesh): its whole length (1268 m) becomes 50, from ~190 m before the spawn to ~1030 m after it. Speed granularity is one value per DecalRoad; shortening the zone would need splitting the road object (geometry change), which this phase does not do.

Northbound carriageway of the divided avenue (2 lanes, 216 m) that Event 01 takes after the signalised junction. Original explicit value 35 mph (15.6464 m/s). The old start (DR272, a local road at 40 km/h since Phase 5) cannot carry 70: the start moves 45 m forward onto DR652 (scenario_patches).

signs.doc: Median side, 0.8 m in front of the concrete barrier (measured: barrier 12.8 m from the axis).
Right-side repeat once the DR253 exit ramp has separated (~160 m after the spawn).

Repeat ~45 m ahead of the scenario spawn, in view at the start (the participant never starts under an unsigned rule). Median side, 0.8 m in front of the barrier: the right side here is the DR253 exit ramp splitting off.
End of the 50 zone on the same carriageway: the freeway limit (120, DR758) is restored with a sign.
At the corridor entry, ~20 m ahead of the Event 01 start.
Repeat after the side junctions (autojunction_86, DR187_2) where traffic joins the corridor.

spawns.doc: New Event 01 start: right lane of DR652, 12 m after the junction, heading along the corridor.

sign_template.doc: Mounting copied from an original West Coast 25 mph sign (road_signs group, sign_speed25 a083b8aa + pole_fence1 f77160d4): sign centre 2.224 m above ground, pole_fence1 upside down (z axis -1) 0.11 m behind the face, origin 1.098 m above ground. Sign face = local -Y (R-19 mesh), so local +Y points along the traffic flow.

scenario_patches.doc: Spec section 32: the start may move when the original route cannot carry 70. Only the start point/heading change; alertSpeedKmh = 70 and rearmSpeedKmh = 65 stay as they are.
